character: Undulating Ohio road course through rolling, wooded terrain. The Keyhole and Carousel are the signature corners; Thunder Valley and the Madness esses demand a well-balanced car.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: blind, fast corner at the end of the front straight
corners.technique: Commit to the blind entry, trust the line
corners.trap: Lifting unnecessarily costs significant time on a corner that's faster than it looks

corners.name: Keyhole
corners.type: tight, technical corner with a difficult, narrow entry
corners.technique: Patient, precise braking, low speed, prioritise a clean exit
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running out of track

corners.name: Madness
corners.technique: Rhythm and smooth inputs through the direction changes
corners.trap: Over-driving any single apex disrupts the whole sequence

corners.name: Thunder Valley
corners.technique: Full commitment, prepare early for the braking zone that follows
corners.trap: Not preparing early enough for the next braking zone

corners.name: Carousel
corners.type: near-360-degree tightening corner with multiple possible lines
corners.technique: Progressive, patient throttle as the corner tightens, use the largest reasonable radius
corners.trap: Apexing too early leaves nowhere to go as the corner keeps tightening
